changelog:
**Major refactor: Switched to hcloud/KooCLI and direct Prometheus HTTP for metric queries; expanded metric coverage to include control-plane/addon telemetry.**

- Replaced Huawei Cloud SDK with `hcloud` (KooCLI) for all supported resource queries (CCE, ECS, ELB, VPC, etc).  
- Prometheus metric queries now use signed HTTP requests to AOM endpoints.  
- Added support for CCE addon metrics: CoreDNS, nginx-ingress, autoscaler, control-plane (apiserver, etcd, controller-manager, scheduler), GPUs/xGPUs, and add-on certificate status.  
- Added `kubectl` integration only for Pod label lookups and deep Kubernetes relationships where cloud APIs are insufficient.  
- Updated security and runtime prerequisites, emphasizing credential handling and required CLI/plugin (kubectl-cce) setup.  
- Cleaned up, merged, or removed scripts now obsolete due to new dispatcher and query model.  
- Expanded documentation and command references for new resource types and query capabilities.
summary: Huawei Cloud CCE Metric analysis skill using the Python dispatcher with hcloud-backed cloud service queries. Use this skill when the user wants to: (1) query...
